answer.summary: Frontend build fails at the Vite/rolldown bundling step with 7 UNRESOLVED_IMPORT errors, e.g. OrganizationDetail.tsx imports ../../graph/EntityGraph, which does not resolve. This is a deterministic module-resolution error, most likely caused by this PR's graph-component changes (a renamed or removed file), so a rerun will fail the same way. Only the first error is visible in the excerpt, so the other six are unconfirmed.
